title: Orchestrator reopen transition
acceptance: `orchestrator.py reopen <id> --to review --reason <text>` exists, is allowed from blocked, changes_requested and approved, and appends a history entry with the reason.
Other source states are refused with a clear error.
Covered by tests in the orchestrator's test suite; docs/workflow/TASKS.md lists the command.
notes: Raised on TASK-0122: after an approved re-scope the orchestrator had no blocked to review transition, so jg approved a hand edit (history entry records it). Replaces that hand edit.
